item.title: Code-execution flaw in UEFI firmware threatens most servers on planet Earth
item.description:
📝 AMI, a maker of motherboards and other hardware, published this pull request last month that detailed the vulnerability and included a code fix. During this process—known as the pre-execution environment boot—the driver uses a network listener to monitor for ICMP errors. When the attacker knows what the target firmware build is, it can plant a “counterfeit event” that executes the malicious code on the CPU in its UEFI firmware environment.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/code-execution-flaw-in-uefi-firmware-threatens-most-servers-on-planet-earth/
